name: service-marketplace
description: Self-hosted Service Marketplace Platform - Deploy managed services on your own infrastructure

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run dev" "pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run dev" "pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run build && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run build && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run lint && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run lint && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run test && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run test && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter @svcmarket/server run clean && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/web run clean && pnpm --filter @svcmarket/worker run clean && rm -rf node_modules
